# `sandbox` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "sandbox" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/sandbox/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | id | required | Unique sandbox id, e.g. "combat-sandbox". |
| `notes` | string | required | What the numbers are for, and which are placeholders. |
| `scene` | ref → scene | required | The sandbox scene (`?scene=<id>`). |
| `dummy` | object | required | The training dummy `spawn dummy` creates. |
| `dummy.health` | integer > 0 | required | Maximum health. |
| `dummy.poise` | integer ≥ 0 | required | Maximum poise; poise damage that empties it staggers the dummy. |
| `dummy.infiniteHealth` | boolean | required | Never dies: health stops at 1 and refills after resetAfterTicks without a hit. |
| `dummy.resetAfterTicks` | integer > 0 | required | Sim ticks without a hit after which an infinite-health dummy refills (180 = 3 s). |
| `dummy.resistances` | map of `"slash"` \| `"pierce"` \| `"blunt"` \| `"fire"` \| `"frost"` \| `"shock"` \| `"arcane"` \| `"poison"` → number 0–3 | `{}` | Damage multiplier per type (0 immune, <1 resists, >1 vulnerable); unlisted = 1. |
| `dummy.regions` | list of `"weakpoint"` \| `"head"` \| `"torso"` \| `"limb"` (at least 1) | required | The hurtbox regions a dummy has by default: head, torso, limb and/or weakpoint. |
| `dummy.regionMultipliers` | object | required | Damage multiplier of a hit on each region (the damage model’s region stage). |
| `dummy.regionMultipliers.weakpoint` | number 0–10 | required |  |
| `dummy.regionMultipliers.head` | number 0–10 | required |  |
| `dummy.regionMultipliers.torso` | number 0–10 | required |  |
| `dummy.regionMultipliers.limb` | number 0–10 | required |  |
| `dummy.radius` | number > 0 ≤ 2 | required | Body radius, metres. |
| `dummy.reactions` | object | required | How it reacts to hits (mw-e04.7). |
| `dummy.reactions.knockbackImpulse` | number > 0 | `300` | Hit impulse (N·s) at or above which a hit knocks it back. |
| `dummy.reactions.knockdownImpulse` | number > 0 | `900` | Hit impulse (N·s) at or above which a hit knocks it down. |
| `dummy.reactions.launchSpeed` | number ≥ 0 | `2` | Upward speed (m/s) a knockback or knockdown adds. |
| `dummy.reactions.mass` | number > 0 | required | Body mass, kg. |
| `attacker` | object | required | The attacker dummy `spawn attacker-dummy` creates: a dummy that swings on a metronome. |
| `attacker.move` | ref → move | required | The move it performs by default (a move with a hitbox). |
| `attacker.periodTicks` | integer > 0 | required | Sim ticks between swings: each starts on a multiple of it (120 = every 2.0 s). |
| `attacker.parryable` | boolean | required | Its swings can be parried (parry arrives with e04.12). |
| `attacker.unblockable` | boolean | required | Its swings go through shields. |
| `player` | object | required | The knight’s placeholder health and poise in the greybox scenes. |
| `player.health` | integer > 0 | required | The knight’s maximum health. |
| `player.poise` | integer ≥ 0 | required | The knight’s maximum poise. |
